steps.why: Requires HWND initialisation. Get it through IDataTransferManagerInterop.GetForWindow and ShowShareUIForWindow.

steps.subject: OnActivated
steps.why: Activation arrives through AppInstance on desktop. Read AppInstance.GetCurrent().GetActivatedEventArgs() in OnLaunched, and handle redirection.

steps.subject: Popup
steps.why: 'Windows.UI.Xaml.Controls.Primitives.Popup' compiles and then behaves differently. Requires XamlRoot; popup is window-scoped.

steps.subject: ResourceLoader.GetForCurrentView
steps.why: View-bound UWP resource loader factory. Use Microsoft.Windows.ApplicationModel.Resources.ResourceLoader and preserve the resource map.

steps.subject: ShowAt
steps.why: Requires XamlRoot. Show the flyout at an element in the window, or set its XamlRoot first.

steps.subject: UIViewSettings.GetForCurrentView
steps.why: Interaction mode is no longer obtained from a UWP current view. Ground the interaction-mode policy in the owning window.

steps.subject: Windows.ApplicationModel.Package.Current
steps.why: 'Windows.ApplicationModel.Package.Current' compiles and then behaves differently. Works from desktop ONLY when packaged with identity (MSIX). Unpackaged callers fail at runtime. Either ship MSIX, or replace with Win32 equivalent (registry/AppData/scheduled tasks/own bookmark store).

steps.subject: ApplicationView
steps.why: 'Windows.UI.ViewManagement.ApplicationView' needs more than a rename. AppWindow exposes Presenter, TitleBar, Icon, Position, Size. Acquire via Window.AppWindow or AppWindow.GetFromWindowId.

steps.subject: CoreDispatcher
steps.why: 'Windows.UI.Core.CoreDispatcher' needs more than a rename. RunAsync(CoreDispatcherPriority, DispatchedHandler) → TryEnqueue(DispatcherQueuePriority, DispatcherQueueHandler). Use DispatcherQueueController for non-UI threads.

steps.subject: IActivatedEventArgs
steps.why: 'IActivatedEventArgs' needs more than a rename. Single union type carries all kinds (Launch, File, Protocol, ToastNotification, …). Switch on Kind property.

steps.subject: KeyboardAccelerator
steps.why: 'Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Input.KeyboardAccelerator' becomes 'KeyboardAccelerator', which renames the type rather than moving a namespace. That is an edit a person has to make. Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Input.KeyboardAccelerator became KeyboardAccelerator.

steps.subject: LaunchActivatedEventArgs
steps.why: 'Windows.ApplicationModel.Activation.LaunchActivatedEventArgs' needs more than a rename. Type changed; properties UWPLaunchActivatedEventArgs exposes legacy data. Update OnLaunched override signature.

steps.subject: RunAsync
steps.why: 'RunAsync' needs more than a rename. Returns bool, not IAsyncAction; priority enum is different. Wrap to keep existing async patterns or migrate to TryEnqueue.

steps.subject: Windows.UI.Core
steps.why: 'Windows.UI.Core' needs more than a rename. InputPointerSource / InputKeyboardSource replace CoreWindow-based input. Get pointer state via InputPointerSource.GetForIsland or per-Element.

steps.subject: ApplicationData
steps.why: Nothing replaces 'Windows.Storage.ApplicationData'. Returns null/throws when unpackaged. Use Environment.SpecialFolder.LocalApplicationData (Win32).

steps.subject: Suspending
steps.why: Remove UWP-only suspension/activation assumptions and use the WinUI 3 window event shape.

steps.subject: SystemNavigationManager
steps.why: Nothing replaces 'SystemNavigationManager'. The shell back button is gone with no replacement. Back has to be built per window, normally the NavigationView back button or a title bar control.

steps.subject: Windows.UI.Xaml.Controls.Pivot
steps.why: Nothing replaces 'Windows.UI.Xaml.Controls.Pivot'. Not ported, by design, and it is not coming back. SelectorBar is the segmented replacement; TabView is the one for tabbed documents. Neither is a drop-in.

steps.subject: RevealBackgroundBrush
steps.why: It exists only in UWP XAML or WinUI 2: only Windows SDK Windows.UI.Xaml.Media.RevealBackgroundBrush; absent from WinUI 3.

steps.subject: RevealBorderBrush
steps.why: It exists only in UWP XAML or WinUI 2: only Windows SDK Windows.UI.Xaml.Media.RevealBorderBrush; absent from WinUI 3.

steps.subject: SystemNavigationManager.GetForCurrentView
steps.why: It compiles and then behaves differently: the UWP system back button has no desktop current view.

steps.subject: ITextDocument4
steps.why: No rule in native-interop-rules.tsv classifies the Com boundary.

steps.subject: Windows.UI.Xaml.Shapes.Path -> Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Shapes.Path
steps.why: Windows.UI.Xaml.Shapes.Path became Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Shapes.Path.
